name: SportsAPI Pro Football
description: Football data from SportsAPI Pro: leagues and seasons, standings and season leaders, live scores and daily schedules, match lineups, incidents, statistics, head-to-head, shot maps and best players, teams, squads, players and managers. API key.
instructions:
## SportsAPI Pro (football)
This connector reads the SportsAPI Pro Football V2 API (`https://api.sportsapipro.com/v2/football`): countries, leagues and tournaments, seasons, standings and season leaders, live scores and daily schedules, match details with lineups, incidents, statistics, head-to-head, shot maps, best players and average positions, teams and squads, players and managers. Every tool only reads.

**Setup**: sign up at https://sportsapipro.com/register, open the Dashboard and copy the key from **API Credentials** into `SPORTSAPIPRO_API_KEY`. It is sent as the `x-api-key` header. Check it with `sportsapipro_get_account_status`.

**Quota**: the daily quota is shared by every sport on the key and resets at midnight UTC: 100 requests a day on the free plan, 7,500 on Pro, 75,000 on Ultra. A 429 means the quota is used up for today; `sportsapipro_get_account_status` shows what is left. 401 means a missing or wrong key, 403 a suspended account.

**Ids**: tournaments, seasons, teams, players, managers and matches have numeric ids. `sportsapipro_search` finds any of them by name; `sportsapipro_list_leagues` lists tournaments by country (slug such as england). A season id is not a year: get it from `sportsapipro_list_tournament_seasons`. Common tournament ids: 17 Premier League, 8 LaLiga, 35 Bundesliga, 23 Serie A, 34 Ligue 1, 7 Champions League. Kick-off times are Unix timestamps (`startTimestamp`, UTC); convert before quoting a time.

**Paging**: `sportsapipro_list_season_matches` and `sportsapipro_list_team_matches` take `direction` (next or last) and a 0-indexed `page`; ask for the next page while `hasNextPage` is true.

**Common workflows**
- Table and leaders: `sportsapipro_search` for the competition, `sportsapipro_list_tournament_seasons`, then `sportsapipro_get_standings` and `sportsapipro_get_top_players`.
- Today and live: `sportsapipro_list_live_matches` or `sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date`, then `sportsapipro_get_match`.
- Match report: `sportsapipro_get_match_incidents`, `sportsapipro_get_match_statistics`, `sportsapipro_get_match_lineups`, `sportsapipro_get_match_shotmap`, `sportsapipro_get_match_best_players` and `sportsapipro_get_match_average_positions`.
- Match preview: `sportsapipro_get_match_h2h` and `sportsapipro_list_team_matches` (direction last) for both teams' recent form.
- Teams and people: `sportsapipro_get_team`, `sportsapipro_get_team_squad`, `sportsapipro_get_player`, `sportsapipro_get_player_statistics`, `sportsapipro_get_manager`, `sportsapipro_get_manager_career`; `sportsapipro_list_countries` to browse by country.

**Limitations**: football only; the key also works for other sports, which this connector does not cover. Market price data and generated match commentary are left out. Coverage depth follows the competition tier: lower divisions can answer fewer statistics or 404.

SPORTSAPIPRO_API_KEY.label: API key
SPORTSAPIPRO_API_KEY.help: Sign up at sportsapipro.com, open the Dashboard and copy the key from API Credentials.
SPORTSAPIPRO_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the key from API Credentials, without spaces or a header name.

verifyHints.401: SportsAPI Pro refused the key. Copy it again from API Credentials on your SportsAPI Pro dashboard; regenerating it invalidates the old one.
verifyHints.403: SportsAPI Pro answered 403: access denied or the account is suspended. Check your account on the SportsAPI Pro dashboard.
verifyHints.429: The daily quota of this SportsAPI Pro key is used up (100 requests on the free plan). It resets at midnight UTC.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_account_status
tools.description: Show the SportsAPI Pro account behind the key: plan, daily request limit, requests used today, remaining requests and when the quota resets (midnight UTC). Use it to check the key or the remaining quota.

tools.name: sportsapipro_search
tools.description: Search football teams, players, managers and tournaments by name and get their ids. The main way to find an id you do not have yet.

q.description: Search text, at least 2 characters, e.g. arsenal, messi, premier league.

tools.name: sportsapipro_list_countries
tools.description: List the countries (football categories) with name, code and flag, to browse competitions by country.

tools.name: sportsapipro_list_leagues
tools.description: List football leagues and cups grouped by country with their tournament ids. Filter with a country slug.

country.description: Country slug in lower case, e.g. england, spain, italy, germany, brazil.

tools.name: sportsapipro_list_tournament_seasons
tools.description: List the seasons of a tournament, newest first, with their season ids (e.g. 76986 for one Premier League season). Every standings, top-players and season-match call needs one.

tournament_id.description: Tournament (competition) id, e.g. 17 Premier League, 8 LaLiga, 35 Bundesliga, 23 Serie A, 34 Ligue 1, 7 Champions League. Find others with sportsapipro_search or sportsapipro_list_leagues.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_standings
tools.description: Get the league table of a tournament season: position, team, matches, wins, draws, losses, goals and points, with promotion and relegation markers. Group stages answer one table per group.

tournament_id.description: Tournament (competition) id, e.g. 17 Premier League, 8 LaLiga, 35 Bundesliga, 23 Serie A, 34 Ligue 1, 7 Champions League. Find others with sportsapipro_search or sportsapipro_list_leagues.

season_id.description: Season id of that tournament, from sportsapipro_list_tournament_seasons (not the year).

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_top_players
tools.description: Get the season leaders of a tournament in one call, keyed by statistic: rating, goals, expected goals, assists, shots, key passes, dribbles, tackles, saves, clean sheets, cards and more, up to 50 players each with appearances.

tournament_id.description: Tournament (competition) id, e.g. 17 Premier League, 8 LaLiga, 35 Bundesliga, 23 Serie A, 34 Ligue 1, 7 Champions League. Find others with sportsapipro_search or sportsapipro_list_leagues.

season_id.description: Season id of that tournament, from sportsapipro_list_tournament_seasons (not the year).

tools.name: sportsapipro_list_season_matches
tools.description: List the upcoming (next) or most recent finished (last) matches of a tournament season, a page at a time: teams, kick-off timestamp, status, score and round.

tournament_id.description: Tournament (competition) id, e.g. 17 Premier League, 8 LaLiga, 35 Bundesliga, 23 Serie A, 34 Ligue 1, 7 Champions League. Find others with sportsapipro_search or sportsapipro_list_leagues.

season_id.description: Season id of that tournament, from sportsapipro_list_tournament_seasons (not the year).

direction.description: next for upcoming matches (default), last for the most recent finished ones.

page.description: Page number, 0-indexed (0 = closest to today). Ask for the next page while the answer says hasNextPage.

tools.name: sportsapipro_list_live_matches
tools.description: List every football match being played right now with tournament, teams, score, status and minute. Use a match id from here with the match tools.

tools.name: sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date
tools.description: List the matches of the top 50 tournaments on one date (fixtures and results): tournament, teams, kick-off timestamp, status and score. totalTournamentsOnDate says how many tournaments play that day in total.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match
tools.description: Get one match: tournament, season and round, teams, status, score by period, kick-off timestamp, venue, referee and managers, with their ids.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match_lineups
tools.description: Get the lineups of a match: formation, starting XI and substitutes per team with shirt number, position, player ratings and statistics, and missing players.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match_incidents
tools.description: Get the incidents of a match in order: goals with scorer and assist, cards, substitutions, VAR decisions, injury time and period scores.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match_statistics
tools.description: Get the team statistics of a match per period (all, 1st half, 2nd half): possession, expected goals, shots, big chances, passes, duels, corners, fouls and more.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match_h2h
tools.description: Get the head-to-head record of the two teams (wins and draws) and of the two managers before this match.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match_shotmap
tools.description: Get every shot of a match with player, minute, position on the pitch, body part, situation, expected goals (xG) and outcome.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match_best_players
tools.description: Get the best-rated players of each team in a match and the player of the match, with their ratings.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_match_average_positions
tools.description: Get the average positions of each team's players on the pitch during a match, with the substitutes who came on.

match_id.description: Match id from sportsapipro_list_live_matches, sportsapipro_list_matches_by_date, sportsapipro_list_season_matches, sportsapipro_list_team_matches or sportsapipro_search.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_team
tools.description: Get one team: name, country, venue with capacity, manager, foundation date, colours, main tournament and recent form.

team_id.description: Team id from sportsapipro_search, a match or a standings row.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_team_squad
tools.description: Get a team's squad: players with position, nationality, shirt number, age, market value and contract expiry.

team_id.description: Team id from sportsapipro_search, a match or a standings row.

tools.name: sportsapipro_list_team_matches
tools.description: List a team's upcoming (next) or most recent finished (last) matches in all competitions, a page at a time: tournament, opponent, kick-off timestamp, status and score.

team_id.description: Team id from sportsapipro_search, a match or a standings row.

direction.description: next for upcoming matches (default), last for the most recent finished ones.

page.description: Page number, 0-indexed (0 = closest to today). Ask for the next page while the answer says hasNextPage.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_player
tools.description: Get one player's profile: team, position, shirt number, country, date of birth, height, preferred foot, estimated market value and contract end.

player_id.description: Player id from sportsapipro_search or sportsapipro_get_team_squad.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_player_statistics
tools.description: Get a player's statistics season by season across competitions: appearances, minutes, goals, assists, cards and rating.

player_id.description: Player id from sportsapipro_search or sportsapipro_get_team_squad.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_manager
tools.description: Get one manager: current team, nationality, date of birth, preferred formation and performance (matches, wins, draws, losses, goals scored and conceded).

manager_id.description: Manager id from sportsapipro_search or a team or match.

tools.name: sportsapipro_get_manager_career
tools.description: Get a manager's career history: the teams coached with start and end dates and the wins, draws and losses at each club.

manager_id.description: Manager id from sportsapipro_search or a team or match.
